hero.headline: Bridging the Most Critical Infrastructure Gap on Earth
hero.subheadline: Africa represents 17% of the world's population but less than 1% of its data center capacity. We are closing that gap in Kenya.

sections.title: The Hidden Opportunity in Digital Infrastructure
sections.body: When global investors look at Africa, they often see a mobile-first economy, but they forget the physical backbone that makes that economy possible. The continent is currently facing a 'compute crisis.' As African banks, governments, and startups move to the cloud, they are forced to host their data in Europe or the US, resulting in high latencies and massive capital flight. Kenya AI Compute is building the alternative. Our market analysis shows that for every 1MW of high-quality data center capacity built in Kenya, there is an immediate 5MW of latent demand. By focusing specifically on AI-grade, high-density infrastructure, we are skipping the 'basic hosting' stage and moving straight to providing the HPC power that will define the continent's digital sovereignty over the next twenty years.
